# Dataset card: `wythoff_n1000`

*Auto-generated by `overthink generate`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate instead.*

Grundy values of Wythoff's game for all positions with both heaps below 1000.

## Game

**Wythoff's game: Grundy values.** Two heaps (x, y). A move removes any positive number of tokens from one heap, or the same positive number from both. Normal play.

## Contents

Every position (x, y) with 0 <= x, y < n.

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| `n` | `1000` |

| | |
|---|---|
| Rows | 1,000,000 |
| File size (Parquet, zstd) | 1.4 MB |
| Sort order | x, y |
| Schema version | 1.0 |

## Schema

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `x` | UInt32 | first heap |
| `y` | UInt32 | second heap |
| `grundy` | UInt32 | Sprague-Grundy value G(x, y); 0 iff P-position |
